The basket lifting system is very inconvenient to add salt. Ironically, the dishwasher gets dirty very quickly near the hinge and washes the dishes very badly. To sum up a product at a top-of-the-range price, junk and which, despite good commercial speeches on gadgets allowing washing in all corners, only washes your dishes very badly. Comments (English): Likes: Good looking unit. Quiet. Dislikes: I don't like angled pegs especially on the bottom rack. Can't put a soup pot in it straight. Totally offends my OCD. This one is closed underneath with water supply in the back. It requires you to purchase a long flex line and then when you push the unit into place that line is isolated against the wall. In my case, an exterior wall which I fear could freeze. I actually purchased a small heater and ran electric under the adjacent sink. I hope this prevents freezing. The electric is in the front, but getting the wire thru the narrow slot was a pain. Must be the same guy who designed my car with an oil filter jammed in a spot too small to fit your hand designed this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): Purchased this dishwasher to replace my 10 year old Whirlpool builder grade machine.
Comments (English): Purchased this dishwasher to replace my 10 year old Whirlpool builder grade machine. Positive aspects of the machine are the dishes have been spotless on all of the cycles. Installation was relatively easy due mostly to the ability to adjust the rear leg(s) from the front with the machine in place. The Dynamic Dry works well however if any plastic containers are stacked where they will pool water you may still have a bit of moisture. Tremendous improvement over the old machine. Overall build quality is good. Challenges: Now in LG's defense I did purchase this machine site unseen from Home Depot on a Black Friday sale however the third rack is too shallow for any larger kitchen tools however has a great system for flatware. We have found that we put all of out flatware there vs the basket. It took three weeks for delivery however the machine arrived on the original promise date. My biggest disappointment is this machine is noisy. The machine we replaced was rated 52 dB and this one is 48dB however is far more disruptive than the old machine. Of particular note is the "whooshing" sounds it makes randomly and it is not the water fill valve. It also has a "clunking" sound although this does not occur all of the time. In summary it seems to be a good dishwasher based on how it cleans. Our homes floor plan has the kitchen partially separated from the living room so we get a bit of a sound break so the noise is disappointing. Would be a bigger issue if our floor plan was completely open.

Sentence (English): I'm very happy with my initial impressions of this dishwasher.
Comments (English): I'm very happy with my initial impressions of this dishwasher. I've been using it for 2-3 months so cannot comment on long term reliability. It replaced a 14-15 year old problem free Whirlpool during remodeling. I'm a fan of the clean front and hidden controls. My initial impression was that the interior fitments were not as substantial as in the older unit but they seem to function well. I tend to use the sensor or normal cycles and they have worked perfectly. I've not previously had a washer with a stainless interior so have been pleased to find the inside of the washer is as spotless as the dishes (using Kirkland Ultrashine pacs) when the cycles are complete. My old model had difficulty drying plastics on the upper rack but this unit is handling them well so far. Really like the third rack for spatulas, etc. I just have to remind myself to unload said third rack. The unit is very quiet. My only real complaint is the rinse agent window. When completely filled the tiny 1/4" bubble window appears dark or the blue color of the rinse agent. After a wash or two I find the window impossible to interpret. The old dishwasher was much superior on this little item.

Sentence (English): After doing much research into dishwashers and several trips to stores to look at these I decided that, yes a upper end Bosch probably was worth the $$ and got one of the last I could find.
Comments (English): After doing much research into dishwashers and several trips to stores to look at these I decided that, yes a upper end Bosch probably was worth the $$ and got one of the last I could find. So far I am happy with the performance of this dishwasher. It has cleaned and dried pretty much everything I have put in it no matter the location inside. No spots and all glass comes out clean. I especially like the versatility of adjustments to rack heights and tines. And all my wine glasses, even the larger ones, fit in and get cleaned (the stem holders were 1 of the plus compared to other high end dishwasher, like KitchenAid). This dishwasher is quiet and seems effecient with water and energy usage. So far, I am very happy with this dishwasher ans I hope that it lasts and continues to perform well over several years. It would be nice if the SS was fingerprint resistant, but this is one of the only cons.

Sentence (English): We've had about 2 months with our new GE dishwasher.
Comments (English): We've had about 2 months with our new GE dishwasher. It's taken some time to adjust to different stacking/organization/storage inside and finding the best ways to put our dishes. It also took a while to find the best setting that worked for us. Pros: Quiet Uses less water Seems to get things pretty clean once you find your best settings Upper & Lower jets Bottle jets (we have a 7mo baby and this does great with bottles and gross coffee cups) Ability to run top and bottom or just one or the other. Delayed wash cycle up to 12 hours (we run it in the middle of the night, love that! ) Adjustable pegs in the bottom rack to accommodate a variety of sizes Looks great, sleek design. Cons: Long run time (b/c of less water used) Completion light goes off and stays off the second you open the door, which doesn't tell others in the household if it's clean or dirty. We mitigated this by a dirty/clean magnet. The top rack has an odd setup IMO and doesn't provide the most flexibility for organizing dishes. All in all I'd buy this again, it's so far been a huge upgrade from our previous GE (which was a beast but it was a matter of time until it's demise).

Sentence (English): I replaced a Thermador unit with this $1,000+ Whirlpool model.
Comments (English): I replaced a Thermador unit with this $1,000+ Whirlpool model. It looks nice on the outside but the components are light and cheaply made. The feet adjustments are a wobbly joke with no front adjuster for the back legs like a Bosch. The insulation "blanket" couldn't be cheaper. And if their engineers couldn't get "new" electrical connections right (quite puzzling frankly), God only knows the engineering on the rest of the unit you can't see (like the circulation & drain pumps).The Whirlpool is certainly louder than the 15 year unit it replaced, but not terrible. It washes as expected but does not dry dishes well and definitely needs a rinsing agent if you want to avoid water spots.I don't expect this unit to last very long based on its construction and this is apparently the new way these appliance manufacturers have figured out how to ensure a perpetual revenue stream. I really wished I listened to Consumer Reports and bought the Bosch 300 or 500 unit. If this Whirlpool unit surprises me re longevity, I will update this review in 15 years.And unlike many of the other reviews that were "collected as part of a promotion" and contain their fair share of exclamation marked comments, we paid for our dishwasher.

Sentence (English): Sadly, I hate this new dishwasher.
Comments (English): Sadly, I hate this new dishwasher. Having previously had a Miele dishwasher which only lasted for eight years, I decided to go with a Bosch this time around. It's stacking system is a frustration to me, which is the main reason for my disappointment. Very difficult to load large items, as so much space is dedicated to plates. It looks great in my kitchen, which has black bench-tops and a lovely black German sink, but that is the only thing I'm happy about. The drying capability of this machine is not as good as my previous Miele, even though I use the "extra dry" option. Items regularly have to be hand-dried as well, many hours after the cycle has finished. Well, a dishwasher is not something one buys very often, so I'm stuck with this one and will continue to remain disappointed.

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher at Lowe's and got it installed on December 23rd, 2022.
Comments (English): I bought this dishwasher at Lowe's and got it installed on December 23rd, 2022. Being on a budget, I had been looking for 4 months for the right dishwasher, but as it came down to Christmas and guests from out of town, I knew I had to come home with one, so with all the boxes checked, this is the one I chose. I had two days of dirty dishes sitting in my sink, so I came home, my ever handy husband installed the dishwasher, and I proceeded to start putting those nasty dishes in. With no rinsing and food dried on some of the dishes, I was pleased to see my dishes (except 3 forks) come out sparkling clean with just a Normal wash! It has a nice third rack with lots of room that holds silverware, lids, and serving utensils. It comes with two small silverware baskets. It sanitizes, has water heating option, and provides a delayed wash option (Yay! ). The Gentle cycle does a good job of washing, but does not allow sanitization. I was quite interested in the door popping open toward the end of the wash cycle. Very nifty! It has a nice blue light letting you know when you have correctly started the machine, and a countdown clock to let you know how much time remains for each cycle. The bottom rack has folding down tines on one side and little nooks for lids and stuff on the other side. The 2nd rack has some nifty features, such as adjustable tines so you can put larger or smaller items on one side. It also has something I greatly value in a dishwasher: an adjustable 2nd rack, where you can raise or lower to provide more room on the 2nd or bottom rack as needed. However, that is also where my problem arose. I have been loving my dishwasher until Sunday, when suddenly the left side of the 2nd rack decided it no longer wished to be adjustable and should only be on the lower adjustment. This was quite confusing for the righthand side, which was still valiantly staying up where it was supposed to be. It was also confusing to me, who did not understand how my lovely, brand new dishwasher could be falling apart already. Since Sunday, I have been using it with both sides on the lower setting, but would really appreciate being able to use the higher adjustment.If I can get it fixed so that it functions as I wish for it to, and provided it continues to hum along, I would definitely recommend this as a good dishwasher.

This was quite confusing for the righthand side, which was still valiantly staying up where it was supposed to be.  It was also confusing to me, who did not understand how my lovely, brand new dishwasher could be falling apart already.  Since Sunday, I have been using it with both sides on the lower setting, but would really appreciate being able to use the higher adjustment.If I can get it fixed so that it functions as I wish for it to, and provided it continues to hum along, I would definitely recommend this as a good dishwasher.

Sentence (English): Our old dishwasher had gotten to the point that it was so noisy, we had to turn up the TV just to hear it in the evening when we turned it on!

We lived for about six months without a working dishwasher (the old one finally smelled hot the last time we used it), that finding a replacement was finally necessary. It has taken me awhile to get used to how to put the dishes into the dishwasher to maximize the space alloted. I do feel I get fewer dishes into this dishwasher because of this over our previous dishwasher.

Sentence (English): Despite the announced decibels, it is quite noisy.
Comments (English): [ Noisy ] || ---------------- || Despite the announced decibels, it is quite noisy. The 2 door menu lights are quite annoying, dazzling. When you turn it on, it takes a few seconds to "wake up" and while the word Miele appears on the screen. Despite being well programmed for water hardness and rinse aid, the glasses came out with a veil. The dishes do not come out dry, despite having tried both options. The automatic door opening at the end, or the one to remain closed. Not everything is bad. The finishes are excellent. The trays run well on the guides. Few configuration options for the distribution of dishes. However, the cutlery tray is very well designed. The right side It can be raised a little, and the one on the left slides towards the center in order to place tall glasses on the rear tray. Four adjustable legs, not 3 as some manufacturers do to reduce costs. The rear leg adjustments are the best I've seen. The hardness of the door springs can be adjusted. A good detail, since not all panels weigh the same. Good quality and good finishes. Too bad it's so noisy, that the lights dazzle and are annoying, and that the final drying leaves something to be desired.
Comments (Original): [ Ruidoso ] || ---------------- || Pese a los decibelios anunciados, es bastante ruidoso. Las 2 luces de los menús de la puerta resultan bastante molestas, deslumbrantes. Al encerderlo, tarda unos segundos en 'despertar' y mientras aparece la palabra Miele en la pantalla. Pese a estar bien programado de dureza de agua y abrillantador, los vasos salían con velo. La vajilla no sale seca, pese a haber probado las dos opciones. La de apertura automática de puerta al finalizar, o la de permanecer cerrada. No todo es malo. Los acabados son excelentes. Las bandejas corren bien por las guías. Pocas opciones de configuración para la distribución de la vajilla. Sin embargo, la bandeja de cubiertos está muy bien diseñada. El lateral de la dcha. Se puede elevar un poco, y la de la izda se desliza hacia el centro para así poder colocar copas altas en la bandeja posterior. Cuatro patas, ajustables, no 3 como hacen algunos fabricantes para abaratar costes. Los ajustes de las patas traseras es de lo mejor que he visto. Se puede regular la dureza de los muelles de la puerta. Un buen detalle, ya que no todos los paneles pesan lo mismo. Buena calidad y buenos acabados. Lástima que sea tan ruidoso, que las luces deslumbren y resulten molestas, y que el secado final deje que desear.

Neutrals: Well, the top rack is interesting. I am not sure it is an improvement, but neither here nor there. The silverware caddy is a step down from earlier hinged designs, and it lacks the useful separate removable small basket that was part of earlier models. I am clicking that I "would recommend to a friend," but would note the caveats.

Neutrals: Well, the top rack is interesting. I am not sure it is an improvement, but neither here nor there. I think that if the lower rack designs were better (see below) it might result in a substantial increase in dish capacity. Cons: 1) The control panel is far too sensitive, so it is prone to activation if you brush your hand along it when opening or closing the door to put dishes in. This is hard to avoid if you open the door all the way to roll out the bottom rack, because it the fully opened door is so low to the floor that you can't easily reach under it enough to shut it with the handle and tend to touch the top edge. Not a fatal flaw but an annoyance. This has been noted in several other reviews, and is an obvious ergonomic design error that one would think should have been noticed in field testing of the design. 2) The rack system of the bottom and middle racks could have been better designed in terms of the spacing, shape, and placement of the tines; the dishes tend to jostle or flip over when the racks are slid in and out, and they clank against each other. We have tried multiple orientations, but this problem persists. This forces spacing the dishes so the dishwasher potential capacity is compromised. 3). The silverware caddy is a step down from earlier hinged designs, and it lacks the useful separate removable small basket that was part of earlier models. We actually kept our old caddy and are using it instead. 4) The regular and pro-wash cycles are very long - in the range of 2.5 to 3 hours or more. This is OK for running overnight, but if you are entertaining and need to run multiple loads, it is cumbersome. Not the other hand, we have noticed that for most situations, the "express wash" with pro-dry does a good job and is only about 1.75 hours. All in all, our impression is solid, but not outstanding. I am clicking that I "would recommend to a friend," but would note the caveats.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher was a replacement to an older Bosch one that quit working on us weeks prior.
Comments (English): This dishwasher was a replacement to an older Bosch one that quit working on us weeks prior. Fortunately I had purchased the Best Buy extended warranty on the Bosch and when it quit there was only 2 weeks left on the warrant so we got very lucky there. The Best Buy crew were professional and polite on the deliver and installation (which Best Buy gave to us for no charge). They arrived on time and were gone within 30 minutes with no issues. This dishwasher is quieter than the Bosch but doesn't dry the dishes as well. We have used different cleaning pods but all have the same results. This isn't a big issue as long was we remember to dry off the tops of items before removing as to avoid water on the floor. Was surprised that a function on this dishwasher is that the door automatically pops open near the end of the drying phase. I thought something had broke when I walked out the first time we used it and saw steam coming out of the open door. Another minor point for this dishwasher is that you need to hold your finger on the power button for a couple of seconds before it will power on. I'm assuming this is a safety issue to avoid and inadvertent start. I would recommend this dishwasher for anyone needing a new one or looking to upgrade their current one.

Sentence (English): It washes dishes well.
Comments (English): It washes dishes well. It will knock off stuck-on fried egg yolk with out prewashing no problem. The dishes are generally more dry when opened that the Kemore it replaced. It is medium level quiet, but not as whisper quiet as the Kenmore. If these are your main goals, go get one. However there are other drawbacks. If you drink wine and want a clip to hold your wine glass, look elsewhere. The main features I was looking forward to enjoying were the bottle washer and the third top rack and they are both a major disappointment. The bottle washer will only fit short bottles and not the 21 oz. HydroFlasks that my kids take to school daily. The third rack takes up too much room above. You may lower the middle rack down to a lower setting unless you have full size plates. In this case the rotating water sprayer on the middle rack will hit the plates. I eventually gave up and ditched the top rack. I can now wash the water bottles and fit a wine glass in the rack and wash my plates at the same time. I guess there's only so much room inside.

Sentence (English): We bought this GE dishwasher to replace a 22 year old Kenmore Elite that finally wore out.
Comments (English): We bought this GE dishwasher to replace a 22 year old Kenmore Elite that finally wore out. We have other GE appliances that we really like but, even on sale, this dishwasher has proven to be poor value. First off, it looks cheaply built on the inside. The keypad looks fragile and has a thin, plastic tab on it that the installer warned us will make the dishwasher completely inoperable if it gets broken, which he said is common. The interior tub is all plastic, and somewhat small, something I missed when we selected this dishwasher. It does not hold as many dirty dishes as our old one even though they're the same size overall. It does wash dishes well but leaves them wet, even with dry boost selected. When you empty the dishwasher after a cycle, the interior remains quite wet and does not evaporate because the door cannot be left open to allow air to enter unless you find some way to prop it open. I will say the washer is very quiet when it's running, much quieter than our previous one. The biggest disappointment with this dishwasher is it broke down after we had used it only a handful of times about a month after it was installed. There was a “critical flood error” due to a bad rinse control valve that caused the washer to continuously pour water into the tub without any way to stop it other than to shut off the water valve under our sink. Fortunately, the washer drained the water into our disposal or our kitchen would have been flooded. Had we run the dishwasher overnight, it would have wasted thousands of gallons of water. GE customer service is the absolute worst. When I called them to get warranty service, it took forever to get through their phone menu to actually speak with someone. And the customer service representative was equally useless, telling me it would take almost a month before the company they chose for service could come out. I discovered on my own that a local appliance repair was an authorized service center and could come the very next day after I called. I had to call GE service to cancel the original work order and then prove to them that the local service center I spoke with could do warranty service before they would agree to set up the appointment! Bottom line: this dishwasher is much lower quality than it appears at first glance and GE warranty service is the worst you will experience. There is no way this dishwasher will last longer than a few years with regular usage. If you do decide to purchase it, be sure to purchase a 5-year extended warranty, too.

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher as a replacement for our previous unit that was over 10 years old.
Comments (English): I bought this dishwasher as a replacement for our previous unit that was over 10 years old. Installation took me about an hour, although someone with more experience could do it in less. The only problem I had is that the hole where the dishwasher goes, in my case, is very tight. The sides of the unit rub against the walls of the cavity, slightly squeezing some points of the dishwasher. This causes the unit door to skew slightly to the right and cannot close fully. The temporary solution for us, at least until the renovation of our kitchen, was not to put the dishwasher completely in the hole, in such a way that it protrudes about 10-15cm in front. In this way, it closes without problems. For the rest, it has been a wonderful dishwasher. It makes little noise when in operation, has multiple functions to customize the wash and with the function of downloading more from the internet. The interior has a lot of space and several options to order and organize all the dishes inside. I can't complain about the cleaning results either, really good. Add to all this that it is a much more efficient unit than models in the past and that the price was very fair with the offer with which I acquired it. A clear recommendation from me, as long as it is a dishwasher that will last me the next 10 years without problems.
Comments (Original): [ Lavavajillas DF455HSS ] || ---------------- || Me he comprado este lavavajillas reemplazando nuestra unidad anterior que ya tenía más de 10 años.La instalación me llevó una hora aproximadamente, aunque alguien con más experiencia podría hacerlo en menos. El único problema que tuve es que el hueco en el que va el lavavajillas, en mi caso, es muy justo. Los laterales de la unidad rozan con las paredes del hueco apretando ligeramente algunos puntos del lavavajillas. Esto hace que la puerta de la unidad se desvie ligeramente hacia la derecha y no se puede cerrar bien del todo.La solución temporal para nosotros, almenos hasta la reforma de nuestra cocina, fue no meter el lavavajillas del todo en el hueco, de tal manera que sobresale unos 10-15cm por alante. De esta manera, cierra sin problemas. Por lo demas, ha sido una maravilla de lavavajillas. Hace poco ruido cuando esta en funcionamiento, tiene múltiples funciones para personalizar el lavado y con la función de descargar más de internet. El interior tiene bastante espacio y varias opciones para ordenar y organizar toda la vajilla en su interior.Tampoco me puedo quejar de los resultados de la limpieza, verdaderamente buenos.A todo esto sumarle que es una unidad bastante más eficiente que modelos en el pasado y que el precio fue muy justo con la oferta con la que yo la adquirí.Una clara recomendación por mi parte, siempre y cuando sea un lavavajillas que me dure los próximos 10 años sin problemas.

Sentence (English): Had really expected a lot from such a branded machine.
Comments (English): Had really expected a lot from such a branded machine. Functions are quite chic and the dishes are also nice and clean. My engine just won't turn on when I press the on button. Nothing happens. If I press the button twice in quick succession, all the functions light up and nothing can be set. The machine remains in this state for the time being. Every now and then all the buttons start flashing wildly. After some time it then jumps into pumping mode. Only after this can I select a program and start it. Sometimes I can get around this error if I press the on button (nothing happens), wait x time (too short=everything lights up and hangs, too long=machine still won't start) and then press it again. But that's not the point. I have no idea whether the electronics are gone or whether the error occurs more frequently. You don't expect that at Siemens
Comments (Original): [ Hardware hui, Software pfui ] || ---------------- || Hatte wirklich einiges erwartet bei so einer Markenmaschine. Funktionen sind durchaus schick und auch das Geschirr wird schön sauber. Nur geht meine Maschine nicht an, wenn ich den An-Knopf drücke. Es passiert nichts. Drücke ich den Knopf 2 mal kurz hintereinander, leuchten alle Funktionen auf und nichts lässt sich einstellen. In diesem Zustand verbleibt die Maschine erstmal. Ab und an fangen dann irgendwann alle Tasten wie wild an zu blinken. Nach einiger Zeit springt sie dann in den Abpumpmodus. Erst nach diesem kann ich erst ein Programm wählen und dieses starten. Manchmal kann ich diesen Fehler umgehen, wenn ich den An-Knopf drücke (nichts passiert), Zeit x warte (zu kurz=alles leuchtet und hängt sich auf, zu lange=Maschine startet noch immer nicht) und diesen dann nochmals drücke. Aber das ist ja nicht Sinn der Sache. Keine Ahnung, ob die Elektronik einen weg hat, oder ob der Fehler häufiger vorkommt. Bei Siemens erwartet man sowas nicht

Sentence (English): (This review was received through a promotion.)
Comments (English): (This review was received through a promotion.) It's been almost two months since I bought the product, and . I expected more. Regarding the installation, I have to say that it is narrower than it advertises, something that has come in handy to install it in the hole where the previous one was. The installation has its details since I have not followed the instructions to the letter, so as not to load the tubes. It brings a series of pieces that must be glued to improve soundproofing. I don't understand why they don't come already installed. Positive aspects: It is quite quiet, although with so much publicity I expected it to be quieter, but it is my opinion, at home they say that it is very quiet. Wash well. The tank is made of stainless steel. It has a third tray. Automatic opening of the door after finishing the wash. The baskets allow you to change the configuration of almost all the rods to adapt it to the cutlery, large, small, . The door is easy to open and does not require an effort like other brands. Negatives: Instructions are confusing. The door has little rigidity, I don't know how durable it will be with so much torsion. It has a WIFI connection but I don't see any use in it since it only serves to see the state it is in and to know when it has finished. I have other dishwashers from other brands and at a lower price and the truth is, they are more versatile and the mobile application is really useful and allows parameter modification, remote start, etc. I do not understand how this LG DF455HSS is not capable of doing any of this. At the end of the wash, a lot of moisture remains in the trays due to their own construction, so if the upper trays are removed first, they will end up splashing the dishes in the lower ones. The indications on the device itself are hidden when it is in operation, however all of them continue to work despite not being visible. What sense does that have? So much mechanism in the lower sprinkler causes me concern regarding its durability but I will know that with the passage of time. I'm also worried about seeing engines for these models for sale, fingers crossed.
Comments (Original): [ Contento con el producto pero me esperaba más ] || ---------------- || (Esta reseña se ha recibido a través de una promoción.) Hace ya casi dos meses que he comprado el producto, y ... me esperaba más.Respecto a la instalación, he de decir que es más estrecho de lo que anuncia, algo que me ha venido bien para instalarlo en el hueco donde tenía el anterior.La instalación tiene sus detalles ya que no he seguido las instrucciones al pie de la letra, para no cargarme los tubos.Trae una serie de piezas que hay que pegar para mejorar la insonorización. No entiendo porqué no vienen ya instaladas.Aspectos positivos: Es bastante silencioso, aunque con tanta publicidad me lo esperaba más silencioso, pero es mi opinión, en casa dicen que es muy silencioso.Lava bien. La cuba es de inox. Tiene tercera bandeja. Apertura automática de la puerta tras finalizar el lavado. Los cestos permiten cambiar la configuración de casi todas las varillas para adecuarlo a los cubiertos, grandes, pequeños, ... La puerta es de facil apertura y no requiere hacer un esfuerzo como en otras marcas.Aspectos negativos: Las instrucciones son confusas. La puerta tiene poca rigidez, no se como de durable será con tanta torsión, ... Tiene conexión WIFI pero no le veo utilidad ya que solo sirve para ver el estado en el que está y para conocer el momento en el que ha finalizado. Poseo otros lavavajillas de otras marcas y de menor precio y la verdad, tienen mayor versatilidad y la aplicación movil es realmente util y permite modificación de parámetros, arranque remoto, etc. No entiendo como éste LG DF455HSS no es capaz de realizar nada de esto.Finalizado el lavado, queda mucha humedad en las bandejas por su propia construcción con lo que si se retiran primero las bandejas superiores acabarán salpicando a la vajilla en las inferiores.Las indicaciones en el propio aparato quedan ocultas cuando está en funcionamiento, sin embargo todas ellas siguen funcionando pese a no estar visibles. ¿Que sentido tiene eso?Tanto mecanismo en el aspersor inferior me causa inquietud respecto a su durabilidad pero eso lo sabré con el paso del tiempo. También me preocupa ver a la venta motores para estos modelos, crucemos los dedos.

Sentence (English): (This review was received through a promotion.)
Comments (English): (This review was received through a promotion.) I bought this dishwasher as a replacement for our previous unit that was over 10 years old. Installation took me about an hour, although someone with more experience could do it in less. The only problem I had is that the hole where the dishwasher goes, in my case, is very tight. The sides of the unit rub against the walls of the cavity, slightly squeezing some points of the dishwasher. This causes the unit door to skew slightly to the right and cannot close fully. The temporary solution for us, at least until the renovation of our kitchen, was not to put the dishwasher completely in the hole, in such a way that it protrudes about 10-15cm in front. In this way, it closes without problems. For the rest, it has been a wonderful dishwasher. It makes little noise when in operation, has multiple functions to customize the wash and with the function of downloading more from the internet. The interior has a lot of space and several options to order and organize all the dishes inside. I can't complain about the cleaning results either, really good. Add to all this that it is a much more efficient unit than models in the past and that the price was very fair with the offer with which I acquired it. A clear recommendation from me, as long as it is a dishwasher that will last me the next 10 years without problems.
Comments (Original): [ Buena Compra! ] || ---------------- || (Esta reseña se ha recibido a través de una promoción.) Me he comprado este lavavajillas reemplazando nuestra unidad anterior que ya tenía más de 10 años.La instalación me llevó una hora aproximadamente, aunque alguien con más experiencia podría hacerlo en menos. El único problema que tuve es que el hueco en el que va el lavavajillas, en mi caso, es muy justo. Los laterales de la unidad rozan con las paredes del hueco apretando ligeramente algunos puntos del lavavajillas. Esto hace que la puerta de la unidad se desvie ligeramente hacia la derecha y no se puede cerrar bien del todo.La solución temporal para nosotros, almenos hasta la reforma de nuestra cocina, fue no meter el lavavajillas del todo en el hueco, de tal manera que sobresale unos 10-15cm por alante. Sentence (English): We like our new Bosch dishwasher because it is pretty quiet.
Comments (English): We like our new Bosch dishwasher because it is pretty quiet. The results are very good. It seems to drink a whole lot of rinse aid (a bottle a week! ) and I was reading that rinse aid residue can poison you. My other complaint is the noise. It runs quietly but there is no way to turn off the rather loud door closing buzzer. You can turn off the machine, but you always get that loud beep when you open/close the door. Also, it is designed so that it holds fewer dishes. My previous d/w had only two trays but yet it held more dishes. Finally, the auto wash is 2 hours and 30 minutes. On my cook days I need to run the appliance four times and it is hard to have enough time in the day to do them all. Yes, there is the 60 minute wash. But it isn't as thorough as the auto wash. So yes, I love my dishwasher but would prefer that it operate a bit faster.

Sentence (English): I used to have an inexpensive Frigidaire; it lasted over ten years and finally became unreliable.
Comments (English): I used to have an inexpensive Frigidaire; it lasted over ten years and finally became unreliable. After consulting Consumer Reports and other sources, Bosch consistently came up with great reviews. Sentence (English): I have always sworn by Bosch home appliances and have had washing machines, fridges and freezers with no problems or complaints for the last 25 years at least.
Comments (English): I have always sworn by Bosch home appliances and have had washing machines, fridges and freezers with no problems or complaints for the last 25 years at least. I have been more than happy to recommend to family and friends.We refitted our kitchen recently and although our trusty 17-year old Bosch dishwasher had never missed a beat or ever had a problem, thought it seemed appropriate to replace it to suit the updated kitchen.What a mistake! Oh, how I wished we had kept our trusty old machine! Yes, the new one connects to the Internet although I still can't see why. I just wish they had not bothered with what in my mind is a pointless feature and kept the quality and good design of the old machine. There are a multitude of buttons and wash options, most of which I will never use. However, there is no 15-minute rinse option like we had on the old Bosch machine. That was so useful when the machine was only partially full and a quick rinse would stop the unwashed load from smelling. I assumed the new machine would have the same program, but I have trawled through the instruction manual and checked online, but unless I have missed it, there doesn't appear to be a rinse program. The shortest wash program seems to be the 'Express' 60-minute option, but at least I can start it from the other side of the world via the Internet, (assuming I have put the detergent tablet in first, which cannot be done via the Internet) but I suppose may prove useful one day! The old machine was stainless steel throughout. The new one is plastic at the bottom, which is functional, but just not the same quality.The bottom tray design is poor. If it is heavily loaded at the front with plates and no counterbalance of pots and pans at the back (it seems natural to load the plates neatly first before the irregular pans next) as it is pulled forward to load the free space at the back, the runners drop into the gap where the door hinges are and comes off the guides. I thought it may have just been me, but the rest of the family have found exactly the same issue.The red coloured handles to pull the trays out are a nice idea and would have been a design improvement over the old machine, but are the wrong design. They have been shaped to pull with a hand from above, but in reality, they need to be pulled from below to take the weight (but are not shaped to suit a hand and have sharp plastic edges) otherwise the bottom tray drops into the hinge void as mentioned above.The water spray arms are manufactured from a much lighter weight flimsy plastic than previously and just not the usual Bosch quality.The drying function is nowhere as effective as the old machine. The crockery more often than not needs to be dried with a tea towel as it is still wet after the wash. The old machine dried so well that the crockery was almost too hot to handle if it had only just finished its cycle. I am assuming that it is because it is designed to use less electricity by not heating to such a high temperature, which is commendable and certainly a good thing with such high energy costs currently. It is just a pity though that they could not have designed the energy efficiency in, without compromising the drying efficiency.I do not generally write reviews when requested, but on this occasion when requested by John Lewis felt that I could use the opportunity to alert potential customers of the drop in quality of this particular Bosch machine and my dissatisfaction with it. I just wish we had kept the bulletproof old machine until it eventually failed - which based on its impeccable performance, would probably have gone on for another 5 to 10 years, or maybe even longer.

Sentence (English): This thing is great on a number of levels: super quiet (as in, can't hear it running); looks amazing; quality seems solid; and great adjustability of racks and tines.
Comments (English): [ Mostly great ] || ---------------- || This thing is great on a number of levels: super quiet (as in, can't hear it running); looks amazing; quality seems solid; and great adjustability of racks and tines.All that said, there are a few pesky things that keep it from 5 stars for us: I'll be darned if our bowls just don't seem to fit right in any of the tine sections; it gets really smelly after a couple days, something that did not happen in our old Frigidaire; the top controls are kind of a pain to use since you have to hold the door partially open to access them; the 3rd rack has its merits but is ultimately kind of a pain to precisely place each silverware item; and finally, the drying works pretty well, but not very well on mugs with concave bottoms, which seem to hold too much water to get dry.So overall, we like a lot of positive elements that these Bosch dishwashers are known for, but feel like there are some issues that seem relatively easy to address in order to make this thing really shine.

Sentence (English): This is a review after one month of use.
Comments (English): [ LG Oven for family of 3 ] || ---------------- || This is a review after one month of use. The style and design is an upgrade for our smaller kitchen. The oven is bigger, but doesn't feel out of place. Having the controls in front has been nice, but now I wish that there was an LED lighting them up for easier morning use. This is a feature of the next oven up. Also in consideration of a sleeping household, we could do without the 5 second song alerting to a heated oven. Haven't figured out how to turn it off yet. Keeping the cooktop clean is a learning curve since we use it 3 times per day. We don't own a razor scraper so I suggest companies to include them in the future. Finally, the storage below only fits half of the baking items that the previous range didn't. Seems sized to fit 4-5 baking sheets. Nevertheless, this oven heats significantly faster than our previous model. We are getting to know the features and hope to experiment with the air fryer soon. We bought this around the Black Friday sales so we saved $700+ off the original price so I suggest capitalizing on deals like that.

Comments (English): The only good thing to say is that it's quiet. Now the bad:. - It doesn't wash well - plates come out with food on them, some plates as if were never touched by water. I was going to write it off as DOA. However, once tried the express cycle (the 1hr quick cycle) and things came out sparkly clean. Tried a few times to confirm the findings - the express cycle washes well, all other cycles do not. That will be nice and well, except there is no drying for the express cycle (cannot be enabled). So, choice is clean and wet or dry and dirty. - No stemware clips and odd rack shape - wine glasses don't stay up. I have various shaped glassware and is hard to arrange on the 2nd rack. No clips for this model either. So I have to do weird arrangements with coffee mugs to support the stemware upright. - The 2nd rack has a weird shape with lots of humps. For example small plates roll off the middle section of the rack. Bottom line, the racks are missing basic features like stemware clips and adjustable tinges and are not well designed to do away with them. Washing quality is puzzling - washes well on express, but doesn't dry, any other wash cycle leaves specs of food and cloudy classware. I'm returning it, but don't know what else to get. They all seem to have some sort of issues. Old dishwashed leaked after 12 years, washed and dried very well, and was noisy.

Sentence (English): We had the last generation of this machine for over ten years and thought this would be at least as good if not better.
Comments (English): We had the last generation of this machine for over ten years and thought this would be at least as good if not better. In fact it is one of those examples where bad design has sneaked into a once good design. The addition of a cutlery tray at the top means it cannot take the long stemmed wine glasses the old machine could - they hit the tray. You can with a faff lower the upper basket but then it is too low to take dinner plates at the bottom. The bottom basket has gaps so large that small cereal bowls fall through and you can no longer place the odd cup in the gaps between plates as they fall through also. A bit more wire would have solved this but instead they have wasted money making it possible to connect to the internet! Unless you have a bank of machines running in a busy restaurant this turns out to be a completely useless feature. Who wants a message a 3am in the morning telling you the dishwasher is done? If I could be bothered with the hassle I'd get a refund and buy another model.

This is well built and engineered, so hopefully able to give another review on its durability and longevity in 10-15 years.

I found one I liked, took pictures, and sent them to my wife, along with comments I liked about it. It was a little more expensive than the ones I researched but felt better built and had more options. This model is full of features, like removeable 3rd rack, adjustable tines in middle rack and several stemware holders that keep the wine glasses from moving around. My wife was sold on these features (mainly stemware) and myself on the ease of use and quietness at 44db. I had to turn up the TV volume when the old one was running. This is well built and engineered, so hopefully able to give another review on its durability and longevity in 10-15 years.

Sentence (English): My landlord needed to replace our Frigidaire dishwasher after the motor died, and went with whatever the appliance guys recommended to fit in the space.
Comments (English): My landlord needed to replace our Frigidaire dishwasher after the motor died, and went with whatever the appliance guys recommended to fit in the space. Unfortunately, I've been disappointed with this replacement. My complaints mirror the others here: - No heated dry option, your dishes come out wet; your options are a spotty air-dry or hand-dry. The "condense dry" doesn't work unless all of your dishes are porcelain. This also makes it harder to run a cycle overnight or leaving the house if you want to open the door for air drying. - The buttons on top of the machine make it impossible to know the time remaining - The inner layout is odd; I feel like it fits fewer dishes, and the utensil rack is inflexible with each small section holding just 1-3 items - The rollers on the racks do not glide easily; I'm constantly pulling out the bottom The only good thing I have to say is that the dishes are coming out clean. I haven't yet had any problems with soap dispensing like others have mentioned; I'm simply using Cascade packs. I am using the vaguely named "boost" function for more heat in hopes it gets the dishes hotter and drier. I would absolutely do your research to find a different product if you can. While I don't know the price paid for my unit, I'm shocked at the retail price on this site, and hope you can find a better option.

Sentence (English): I'll hit the good first because there isn't much - this is a very quiet dishwasher, although when it pumps the water out it must have a very strong pump as it is very loud and will startle you the first couple of times it pumps the water out.
Comments (English): [ Waaay overrated ] || ---------------- || I'll hit the good first because there isn't much - this is a very quiet dishwasher, although when it pumps the water out it must have a very strong pump as it is very loud and will startle you the first couple of times it pumps the water out. Now the bad. Installation: the dishwasher has this 3rd small extra shelf at the top which isn't much use but it does consume vertical space meaning you can't do the water and electrical hookups from the front of the dishwasher, after you slide it into the cabinet, like my old one could so you have to hook it up and then slide it in. Also, the leveling feet can ONLY be used to do minor 1/8” leveling - I needed to raise my dishwasher up about 1/2” - I was shocked to find these feet can't do that. Worse, the feet are made of very soft plastic and it is very hard to turn them to raise/level the dishwasher and so the plastic “strips out” almost immediately. Usage: There is only one detergent dispenser - I like two as I use LemiShine and detergent. Worse, the detergent door is very hard to close (it is hard to get it to stay closed) - I know this is going to stop working very very soon. Loading: The tines on the racks are arranged/spaced very awkwardly - we have “normal” dishes but other then regular plates both my wife and I are having a hard time figuring out an effective way of loading this thing. Cleaning: I suppose all new dishwashers may be this way since they try to use so little water, but we have to wash/scrub our dishes before putting them in this dishwasher or they won't come clean - even then sometimes they come out with a haze or some dried-on food that sometimes even comes from a different dish altogether but that settles on one of the plates. Bottom line - don't buy this. Not sure what to buy but likely I'll be selling this one one ebay and trying to find something else.

Sentence (English): Pros: does a good job washing, rarely have missed bits.
Comments (English): Pros: does a good job washing, rarely have missed bits. Quite quiet. Pretty important parts of the job of a dishwasher. Lots of space, takes lots of plates particularly.Dinner plates still fit even with the middle shelf lowered.Cons: find it quite hard to stack efficiently. The top rack is useful for cutlery if fiddly to load. Easy to unload despite not being able to lift it out as you would a basket. Just load all items of the same type together and you can swipe them all out in one go, straight into the drawer, no sorting. The middle basket only has one area (down the left hand side) where mugs are happy, the right hand side isn't wide enough for mugs, they tip over towards the middle. Find it quite hard to stack bowls down the two middle sections. The middle section was only deep enough for jugs etc when lowered to its lowest setting (good that it is adjustable though). The bottom rack is also tricky to stack - at the back, there are special racks to 'brace' taller items but I find they just stop plates from sitting properly. You can remove them but the plate racks themselves aren't very sturdy and seem to need the support the extra bracing thingies provide. The eco cycle is very long - nearly five hours. This is okay but leaving it overnight means that by the time you open the door in the morning, everything is cold and doesn't dry well. The extra dry setting makes no difference! Plastics and anything that pools water on top (mugs) will still be wet. This is a real disappointment. I wish one of the models with the auto-door open feature had been available.

Unfortunately, I've been disappointed with this replacement.My complaints mirror the others here:- No heated dry option, your dishes come out wet; your options are a spotty air-dry or hand-dry. The "condense dry" doesn't work unless all of your dishes are porcelain. This also makes it harder to run a cycle overnight or leaving the house if you want to open the door for air drying. - The buttons on top of the machine make it impossible to know the time remaining- The inner layout is odd; I feel like it fits fewer dishes, and the utensil rack is inflexible with each small section holding just 1-3 items- The rollers on the racks do not glide easily; I'm constantly pulling out the bottomThe only good thing I have to say is that the dishes are coming out clean. I haven't yet had any problems with soap dispensing like others have mentioned; I'm simply using Cascade packs. I am using the vaguely named "boost" function for more heat in hopes it gets the dishes hotter and drier. I would absolutely do your research to find a different product if you can. While I don't know the price paid for my unit, I'm shocked at the retail price on this site, and hope you can find a better option.

Sentence (English): It was time to bring a new one into the house.
Comments (English): [ 1A washing machine ] || ---------------- || It was time to bring a new one into the house. Dishwashers are somehow always at their best when they are inconspicuously doing their job. So if there's nothing to complain about, just walk around and, of course, make the plates and pots sparkling clean. You do it and it's great! Especially with built-in devices, it is an advantage if the new device comes from the same stable as the old one. Removal and installation are uncomplicated. Everything works as before. When it comes to the operating logic, evolution rather than revolution is the order of the day at Siemens. Good this way! Then you can start without reading manuals for pages. The new one doesn't want to deprive us of app assistance either. The setup works fine. And we are already informed when the wash cycle is over, when rinse aid and co. are running out, etc. The latter is particularly practical. All other info is nice. Of course, a dishwasher cannot announce anything too spectacular. Ultimately, the decisive factor for this model was the lower energy consumption. Whether a cutlery basket or drawer is more a matter of taste. Both have their justification. In short, you certainly can't go wrong with the device. The technology is mature and I'm optimistic that we'll be working together again for a good ten years. □□
Comments (Original): [ 1A Abwaschmaschine ] || ---------------- || Es war an der Zeit eine Neue ins Haus zu holen...Geschirrspüler sind irgendwie immer dann am besten, wenn sie unscheinbar ihren Dienst verrichten. Wenn es also nichts zu klagen gibt, sie einfach laufen und selbstverständlich die Teller und Töpfe blitzeblank machen. Das tut Sie und zwar prima!Gerade bei Einbaugeräten ist es von Vorteil wenn das neue Gerät aus dem gleichen Stall kommt wie das Alte. Aus- und Einbau klappen unkompliziert. Alles passt wieder wie vorher. Bei der Bedienlogik ist bei Siemens Evolution statt Revolution angesagt. Gut so! Dann kann es losgehen, ohne seitenweise Handbücher zu studieren. App-Assistenz will uns auch die Neue nicht vorenthalten. Die Einrichtung klappt gut. Und schon wird uns verkündet wann der Spülgang vorüber ist, wann Klarspüler und Co. zur Neige gehen usw.. Gerade letzteres ist praktisch. Alle anderen Info sind nett. Allzu Spektakuläres kann ein Geschirrspüler aber naturgemäß nicht verkünden. Sentence (English): My landlord needed to replace our Frigidaire dishwasher after the motor died, and went with whatever the appliance guys recommended to fit in the space.
Comments (English): [ Washes well, but has odd and lacking features ] || ---------------- || My landlord needed to replace our Frigidaire dishwasher after the motor died, and went with whatever the appliance guys recommended to fit in the space. Unfortunately, I've been disappointed with this replacement. My complaints mirror the others here:. - No heated dry option, your dishes come out wet; your options are a spotty air-dry or hand-dry. The "condense dry" doesn't work unless all of your dishes are porcelain. This also makes it harder to run a cycle overnight or leaving the house if you want to open the door for air drying. - The buttons on top of the machine make it impossible to know the time remaining. - The inner layout is odd; I feel like it fits fewer dishes, and the utensil rack is inflexible with each small section holding just 1-3 items. - The rollers on the racks do not glide easily; I'm constantly pulling out the bottom. The only good thing I have to say is that the dishes are coming out clean. I haven't yet had any problems with soap dispensing like others have mentioned; I'm simply using Cascade packs. I am using the vaguely named "boost" function for more heat in hopes it gets the dishes hotter and drier. I would absolutely do your research to find a different product if you can. While I don't know the price paid for my unit, I'm shocked at the retail price on this site, and hope you can find a better option.

Sentence (English): We purchased this dishwasher in September 2020 at the incredible Gray's Appliance in Melrose, MA.
Comments (English): We purchased this dishwasher in September 2020 at the incredible Gray's Appliance in Melrose, MA. We have purchased numerous appliances at Gray's through the years and have always had a great experience. This dishwasher was, for two years, a dream come true. It did its job perfectly, efficiently and without any problems. Then, suddenly and out of the blue, this past month it began to simply stop in the middle of its cycle, and began to blink its Clean Light a set number of times while making a set number of beeps, silence, beeps. I subsequently have come to understand that the blinking light and the beeps are the dishwasher's "language" to inform the user what is wrong. The good folks at Gray's came out for a look. Turns out that the motor of the dishwasher is gone as are Vent Wax Meter and the Owi. Replacing these items would entail over 500 dollars. Sadly, we're going to have to purchase a new dishwasher as we have no desire to "throw good money after bad". Surely a high quality company as is KitchenAid can do better. I urge anyone purchasing this machine to get a strong warranty. Thank you.

Sentence (English): Our brand new GE dishwasher needed to be replaced 14 months after purchase due to poor work by Lowes installers.
Comments (English): [ Terrible Installation; Unit Ruined in 14 Months ] || ---------------- || Our brand new GE dishwasher needed to be replaced 14 months after purchase due to poor work by Lowes installers. All of a sudden, it would only run for 5-10 minutes before shutting off. While at our home to install the dishwasher, the installer shocked himself with the wiring, despite us asking if he wanted the breaker turned off. The hose installed under the sink was not trimmed to fit the space, leaving close to two feed to additional hose in the cabinet. The unit was screwed directly into our cabinets and was not very secure. When the dishwasher stopped working, we had our plumber/ electrician stop in to take a closer look. Upon looking at the unit, he found that the sound dampening piece that should have gone around the unit had not been installed, the gasket that should have gone around the dishwasher to hold it in place was never installed, and instead, it was screwed into the cabinets (as mentioned above). Because of this, the frame of the dishwasher had been stretched over time, leading to the unit being ruined and unable to be repaired. Additionally, our plumber found that the electric was not run through a gang box. Instead, the wires running from the unit to the power outlet were simply left exposed.Additionally, while here for the dishwasher, the installers took it upon themselves to "fix" other things in our house. 1) The door to the under-sink cabinet, which had previously hung open no more than half an inch, now remains open an inch or two all the time. 2) The storm door on the front of our house was "very bad" (dishwasher installers words, not mine), yet he could not tell us what was "very bad" about the door. He proceeded to fiddle with the hinges, and now there is a 3-4" high gap at the bottom of the door where air can get in and out of the house. Needless to say, we will never be using Lowes installers again.

The silverware basket is removable for easy unloading, however, it very clumsy to attach back to the lower rack and constantly falls off because two very small pieces of plastic are supposed to hold it in place. The latch for the cover of the basket also broke off within the first month, leaving just a loop of metal that is now keeping it closed. Water will pool on any glass or vessel that is not perfectly flat even after the dry cycle is completed so you will need to hand dry most items. I am really disappointed with the quality of this dishwasher and will need to replace the whole unit now after only a few years of use.

Sentence (English): I've owned this for a few months now and use it daily with the Auto cycle.
Comments (English): [ Pretty good dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I've owned this for a few months now and use it daily with the Auto cycle. Dishes always come out clean and the top 3rd rack for cutlery is the best. This saves a lot of room for dishes and pots and pans. I don't need to use the two included cutlery baskets. A few downsides. Although quiet, I would say not noticeably more quiet than the dishwasher I previously owned. Also the Bosch sits a little higher off the floor so I can't see the display under the cabinet while the dishwasher is running. I would probably get the one with the front display next time. The door makes a fairly loud clunk when opening and closing. Nothing serious and I would consider Bosch again. Lastly, by default the washer stays on after a cycle, but you can set the dishwasher to shutoff in the settings.
